title: imbalanced data oversampling through subspace optimization with bayesian reinforcement
core_idea: Introduce an oversampling method that generates synthetic minority samples by performing nonlinear optimization of a class-sensitive objective within selected feature subspaces; suitable subspaces are identified via a Bayesian reinforcement strategy using Dirichlet smoothing to account for class density and support explainability.
tldr: A method for creating synthetic minority samples by optimizing in explainable feature subspaces chosen through Bayesian reinforcement (Dirichlet smoothing) to better address class imbalance.
